tickets.title: Raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer
tickets.text: Raise the monthly transfer from Velvet Acorn Custody to Teacup Comet Bank checking for Liora Pebblefizz from $3,500 to $4,200 starting next cycle, supporting taxable-account distributions that supplement pension and Social Security income.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-07-24 to raise Velvet Acorn Custody monthly checking transfer $3,500-to-$4,200 next cycle.

tickets.title: Reconcile $3,500 transfer against Liora's utilities and home maintenance
tickets.text: Provide support to reconcile the $3,500 monthly transfer from Velvet Acorn Custody against Liora Pebblefizz's approximately $4,200 in utilities and home-maintenance costs, given her Teacup Comet Bank checking balance of about $24,000.
tickets.evidence: By 2024-07-26, support is needed: file $3,500 versus Liora’s about-$4,200 utilities/home-maintenance.
